name: The Wonderful Puppet Circus
source:
You studied theater, thinking it would be the exception, but no, the world dealt you a harsh blow of reality. You got a terrible job, and in search of something better, you went to an interview. That interview led you to a puppet circus. At first, you were supposed to go to the big top, but perhaps destiny is guiding you to something much greater. Perhaps all this isn't a coincidence, and you really are their, salvation? 

[From [url=https://jerichowo.itch.io/under-contract]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你当年攻读戏剧专业时，满心以为自己会成为脱颖而出的例外；可现实却给了你一记残酷的重击。干着一份糟心工作的你为了寻觅更好的出路前去参加面试，结果阴差阳错来到了一座木偶马戏团。起初你本该前往主帐篷工作，但命运似乎正指引着你走向某种更加宏大的使命。或许这一切绝非巧合——你真的就是他们翘首以盼的救星？

[摘自[url=https://jerichowo.itch.io/under-contract]itch.io[/url]]
